title: Flappy-style one-tap game with CharacterBody2D physics and object pooling
prompt: Build a one-tap flappy-style game for Android in this empty folder: a CharacterBody2D bird with gravity (set velocity then move_and_slide()), tap anywhere to flap, pipe pairs spawned from a pooled set of scenes scrolling left with a random gap, score +1 per pipe passed, Game Over with restart. Portrait 720x1280, gl_compatibility. Include tests/smoke_test.gd that runs the main scene ~2 s and prints SMOKE_TEST_OK. Must pass godot_verify.
